---
name: Task request
about: Propose adding or changing a governed HUGO task row
labels: task
---

## Proposal

One sentence: what capability/behavior should exist.

## Why

Which milestone/objective it serves, and why existing governed tasks do not cover it.

## Proposed task row

Suggest the fields the ledger uses: milestone, objective, exact scope, expected module,
prerequisites, constraint, acceptance criteria, tests, non-goals, evidence, HW/device.

## Boundary

What this explicitly will NOT do (authority, storage, retrieval, future milestones, …).

> A task request is a proposal only. Work remains authorized exclusively by an accepted
> `docs/HUGO_TASKS.md` row, decided by the architecture authority.
